verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a one-step 'Deploy to production from chat' capability plus a hosting/publish flow where you can set visibility (public/private) and attach a custom domain, giving founders a path to a live URL. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that the single publish click reliably works end-to-end (one community report describes deployment ending up on an undisclosed platform with broken functionality), and no first-party walkthrough showing the exact one-click UX.
